# Ideal customer profile

## Firmographics

Companies of twenty to two hundred people that sell software to other
businesses, most of them between their seed round and their Series A, and
almost all of them running marketing with one person or two.

## Felt needs

They cannot say what the last quarter taught them. The material calls this
"nobody can answer the question at the start of a quarter", and it comes up in
both the profile note and the pricing conversation.

## Use cases

They write down what they decided and why, once, and then read it back the next
time the same question comes around. The second use is handing a new hire the
same record instead of a week of meetings.

## Current solutions

A spreadsheet nobody updates, a folder of documents nobody can find, and, most
often, nothing at all.

## Technographics

They already run a customer record system and a product analytics tool, and the
notes name both. Nothing in the material says they run anything for their own
planning.
